services.name: Kids BJJ
services.desc: Currently we offer Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu for kids ages 6-15. Our suggestion is for you to have your child try a class first to see what they think. Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu (BJJ) is a martial art, combat sport, and self-defense system that focuses on grappling, take-downs, and most importantly ground fighting. It originated from the Japanese fighting style of Judo and was refined in Brazil through Helio Gracie (father of BJJ). It's a growing sport that is gaining traction internationally in part through the UFC. Here are five of the top reasons your kids should train BJJ. In 2012 the Center for Disease Control (CDC) estimated that 33% of American children and adolescents were overweight or obese.
